title: World Settlement Footprint (WSF) Tracker
description: A global, cloud-native GeoZarr dataset for monitoring settlement dynamics at 10 m resolution. The WSF Tracker records when each pixel was first identified as built-up, updated every six months since July 2016. It was developed by the German Aerospace Center (DLR) and MindEarth, with support from the European Space Agency's Global Development Assistance (GDA) programme, from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations processed in Google Earth Engine. The `wsf_tracker` variable (int8) encodes a biannual date index: 0 = nodata, 1 = built-up by July 2016, 2–20 = first built-up in the six-month period ending on the matching date (20 = July 2025 to January 2026). Published as a multiscale pyramid: group 0 is native resolution and must be used for analysis; groups 1–12 are overviews built with `min` aggregation, for browsing only.
